_comment: How the skill outputs. Primary output is always the validated raw JSON-LD ({"@context":…,"@graph":[…]}) printed in chat with NO <script> wrapper — this is the paste-ready form for Storyblok's Structured Data Markup field, which adds the <script> tags itself. Leaving the <script type="application/ld+json">…</script> wrapper in breaks that field, so mention the wrapper only as an optional note for a direct <head> embed. The chat block and the Drive .json are identical (both raw JSON-LD). Additionally: save the raw .json into the Schema Markup Drive folder, and append a row to the tracking log Sheet (maintained by find-by-title -> read -> merge -> recreate, because this Workspace blocks in-place append). If the Drive connector is unavailable, fall back to writing the .json + a local CSV to the working dir and still print the raw JSON-LD chat block.
